connector.name: Play Console MCP
connector.registryDescription: Manage Google Play Console: releases, listings, monetization, reviews, and Android Vitals.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package play-console-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wiseappsai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
env.description: Inline Google service-account key JSON (recommended). Alternatively set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a key file path.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to a Google service-account key file (alternative to PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON).

env.name: PLAY_DEVELOPER_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: Numeric Play developer account id. Required only for the `users` (permissions) toolset.

env.name: PLAY_REPORTS_BUCKET
env.description: Cloud Storage report-export bucket for the `play_reviews_export` and `play_stats_export` tools — the value from Play Console > Download reports > 'Copy Cloud Storage URI' (pubsite_prod_rev_...). Not the developer account id.

env.name: PLAY_STORAGE_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to a credentials JSON used only for the storage/reviews-export client. The report buckets usually can't be granted to a service account; locally `gcloud auth application-default login` is auto-detected instead.

env.name: PLAY_TOOLSETS
env.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable, or 'all'. Toolsets: releases, store_listing, monetization, commerce, reviews, users, devices, advanced, vitals, reports, workflows.

env.name: PLAY_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only actions.
